title.ko: 개인정보 자동 수집 장치를 통해 제3자가 행태정보를 수집하도록 허용하는 경우 그 수집·이용 및 거부에 관한 사항

rules.statement: When third parties are allowed to collect behavioral data via devices on own web/app, state per device: name, type, collecting company, behavioral data collected, purpose.

check.expr: every(section.S15.rows, r => r.deviceName && r.deviceType && r.collector && r.items && r.purpose)

rules.statement: Explain how to block it in web browsers or on the mobile device; for apps not using a mobile browser, give in-app or device-level steps.
Periodically check installed third-party devices, necessity and items (operator checklist, not policy text).
Details may be provided in a separate linked window.

goodPatterns: Separate web and app tables: device name | type (JavaScript tag, pixel, SDK) | collecting company | data collected | purpose; followed by browser and device blocking steps.

commonDefects.defect: Third-party SDKs present in the app but not listed (recommended item; audit as warning).
Collecting company named only as 'ad partners'.

extractionHints: pixel, tag manager, ad SDK, analytics SDK names
